name: MVP-1 on lab_moon (Star Slop phase 3, internal/sim movers.go path movers + zones.go): alice walks from the jet bridge through the open door into the cabin and stands in the aisle; at 14 s the door shuts and MVP-1 climbs 110 m (she rides on its floor, its own 1 g holding her through space), crosses to 50 m over the Moon by 26 s, then the floor opens and the drop pods throw her down onto the plateau; bob dawdles on the jet bridge, misses it and stays on Earth.
